note: Frozen. Tasks may be ADDED in a later version with a new id; existing tasks are never edited. A corpus that can be rewritten around current behaviour measures nothing.

scoring.rule: A sparse artifact never wins. Missing required content scores zero on semantic regardless of how clean it validates.

tasks.intent: Show a three-tier web application: browser, application server, database.
tasks.structural: no findings above INFO; every connector reaches its target
tasks.perceptual: the direction of dependency is readable without reading the labels
tasks.humanQuestion: Could a new engineer name the three tiers from the picture alone?

tasks.intent: A process with exactly one start, one decision that branches two ways, and two distinct ends.
prohibited: a decision drawn as a rectangle
tasks.structural: F001 and F002 must not fire; both branches labelled
tasks.perceptual: the diamond reads as a judgement, not a rotated box
tasks.humanQuestion: Is it obvious which branch is which without tracing the lines?

tasks.intent: Three roles, a process that hands over between all three in order.
requiredObjects: at least one step per lane
tasks.structural: no member collides with its lane; lane crossings accepted with a reason
tasks.perceptual: which role performs each step is readable at a glance
tasks.humanQuestion: Can you tell who does what without following an arrow?

tasks.intent: A mechanical unit with three callouts naming its parts, annotations on an overlay.
prohibited: a callout that touches the part it points at
tasks.structural: annotations on an overlay page; no L021
tasks.perceptual: each callout unambiguously indicates one part
tasks.humanQuestion: Does any callout appear to point at the wrong thing?

tasks.intent: Six nodes in two columns, five connectors, no crossings.
tasks.structural: no L006 without a hop; no L004
tasks.perceptual: no two connectors read as one line
tasks.humanQuestion: Can each connector be traced end to end without ambiguity?

tasks.intent: Given T01's artifact, rename one node and re-route only what that breaks.
tasks.structural: the diff touches only the renamed node and its connectors
tasks.humanQuestion: Would a reviewer see a small, reviewable change?

tasks.intent: An elevation at a stated scale with two dimensioned runs.
tasks.structural: wireframe provenance preserved; export refuses on stale geometry
tasks.humanQuestion: Do the stated dimensions match what the drawing shows?

tasks.intent: A recognisable single object, no labels, silhouette only.
prohibited: a text label naming the object
tasks.perceptual: a viewer names the object correctly without being told
tasks.humanQuestion: What is it? Ask before revealing the intent.

tasks.intent: NEGATIVE CASE. A validator-clean diagram that says almost nothing.
tasks.structural: will validate clean — that is the trap
tasks.perceptual: should score near zero on semantic completeness
tasks.humanQuestion: Does a clean log tempt the scorer into passing this?
tasks.expectation: A system that scores this well has a broken rubric.

tasks.intent: NEGATIVE CASE. Structurally perfect, semantically incoherent — correct shapes wired in a meaningless order.
tasks.perceptual: the process it depicts cannot actually happen
tasks.humanQuestion: Would someone following this diagram get stuck?
tasks.expectation: Structural score high, semantic score low. Any system reporting one number hides this.

tasks.intent: NEGATIVE CASE. An illustration whose outline reads as the wrong animal or object.
tasks.humanQuestion: What does it look like? Not: what is it meant to be?
tasks.expectation: Calibration case. The farm-animal sheep that read as a stegosaurus is the reference failure.

tasks.intent: NEGATIVE CASE. Decorative marks that accidentally read as letters or symbols.
tasks.humanQuestion: Do any marks read as characters?
tasks.expectation: Calibration case. Half-tone spots that dithered into plus-signs are the reference failure.

tasks.intent: A build pipeline with a failure path that returns to an earlier stage.
prohibited: a return path that crosses a stage body
tasks.structural: no L004; the return is a single traceable path
tasks.perceptual: the loop reads as a loop
tasks.humanQuestion: Is it clear where a failure sends you back to?

tasks.intent: Twelve nodes with long labels in a constrained area.
requiredText: all twelve labels in full, not truncated
prohibited: abbreviating a label to make it fit
tasks.perceptual: readable without zooming past the legibility floor
tasks.humanQuestion: Can every label be read at one glance?

tasks.intent: A room interior from a stated camera, with three objects at correct relative depth.
prohibited: an object floating off its surface
tasks.structural: camera and dimensions preserved as provenance
tasks.perceptual: depth cues agree with each other
tasks.humanQuestion: Does anything appear to float, or sit at the wrong distance?

tasks.intent: Edit a prior artifact such that a previously accepted finding must lapse.
tasks.structural: the acceptance must be reported stale, not silently retained
tasks.humanQuestion: Did the system notice its own prior judgement no longer applies?
